study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.
reason: The abstract reports overall prostate cancer and nonaggressive disease, defined as clinical stage I/II and Gleason score below 7. It does not establish an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incidence analysis. The total analytic sample is not stated directly and was not inferred by summing cases and controls.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Serum 25(OH)D was not associated with overall prostate cancer (Q4 vs Q1: OR, 0.73; 95% CI, 0.40-1.33; P for trend = .25), although there were apparent inverse associations for nonaggressive disease (global P = .03, clinical stage I/II, and Gleason score <7) and among men ≥62 years old (P for interaction = .04) that were restricted to Q3.
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is explicitly for overall prostate cancer. The accompanying nonaggressive analysis does not make this row or article an aggressive endpoint.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
